input_text: Multi-tenant SaaS analytics dashboard. Each tenant has isolated data. Real-time event processing with 5-second latency. Must support custom metric definitions per tenant. Compliance: SOC2, GDPR. Tech preference: TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis.

IoT device management platform for 100k+ devices. Devices send telemetry every 30 seconds. Need real-time dashboards, alerting rules, and device fleet management. MQTT for device communication. Time-series data storage. Must handle device firmware updates over-the-air.

Payment processing platform for marketplace. Split payments between buyers and sellers. Escrow for high-value transactions. PCI-DSS compliance required. Must handle 5000 transactions/minute. Multi-currency support. Real-time settlement reporting.

Electronic health records system for a hospital network. HIPAA compliance mandatory. Must integrate with existing lab systems (HL7/FHIR). Role-based access (doctor, nurse, admin). Audit logging for all data access. Must support offline mode for field nurses.
